amortization.note: Inferred from TPBank's 'Điều kiện, điều khoản cho vay tiền mặt tín chấp, giải ngân qua thẻ ghi nợ tiêu dùng trao ngay' (BM03.SP62/CN/TD v1.1): 'Khoản trả hàng tháng đều nhau, bao gồm một phần gốc và lãi', interest on the actual outstanding principal × actual days ÷ 365 (reducing balance). We link this T&C to TPFico because it matches the TPFico FAQ: free payment account + debit card opened at application, cash out via ATM, contract copy via hotline 1900 63 66 33, and the same 5-day 'giấy cam kết thanh toán' rule with a penalty. The TPFico pages do not link the PDF. FLAT-vs-REDUCING TEST: no lender worked example (amount, term, instalment) exists for TPFico, so the label could not be checked against numbers. It rests on the contract formula only (interest = actual outstanding principal x rate x days / 365). The only TPFico example with an instalment (10 trieu / 12 thang / 972.000 dong) is on the unofficial tpbfico.com.vn site and was not used.

products.notes: LENDER OF RECORD (checked 2026-11-02): TPFico is a business unit of TPBank, not a separate licensed company. Evidence: (1) tpb.vn notice of 26/01/2022 on early-settlement fees ends 'TPFico thuộc TPBank' and opens 'Dịch vụ tài chính tiêu dùng (TPFico)'; (2) the TPFico FAQ has customers pay into a payment account opened at TPBank when the loan is approved, or into the account named 'TÀI KHOẢN THU HỘ TPBANK - TPFICO' held at Ngân hàng TMCP Tiên Phong; (3) the App Store listing 'TPFico Mobile for Customer' is published by 'TienPhongBank' (seller and provider); (4) TPBank's cash-loan T&C (BM03.SP62) names TPBank as the lender ('TPBank là bên cho vay') and matches the TPFico FAQ in hotline, mechanics and penalty wording; (5) the SBV list of finance companies (as of 30/09/2026) has no TPFico entry. Not found: a TPFico-branded contract form that prints the lender's name. lenderOfRecord stays 'tpbank'. RATE: none published on tpb.vn for TPFico (page says only 'lãi suất cực kỳ ưu đãi'; contract says the rate is set and notified at approval). The independent site tpbfico.com.vn (WordPress, Gmail contacts, comment spam, a lead form) publishes rates 'từ 1%' to 2.17%/tháng and a 10 triệu / 12 tháng / 972.000 đồng example; it is a lead-generation site, not an official source, so none of its figures are stored. The insurance example is a premium example only, not a loan-cost example.

products.notes: New product found on the TPBank unsecured-loan listing (it was not covered in the first pass). Lender is TPBank: the contract template 'Đề nghị vay vốn kiêm Hợp đồng cho vay (khách hàng sử dụng nền tảng Kredivo)' prints 'Ngân hàng TMCP Tiên Phong' as lender and the T&C calls TPBank 'Bên Cho Vay'; Kredivo (Công ty cổ phần Kredivo Việt Nam) only runs the app. The contract template has blank fields for 'lãi suất thông thường' and 'lãi suất ưu đãi (áp dụng có điều kiện)', so the rate is set per loan and may include a conditional promotional rate; no figure is published. Interest = actual balance × rate × days ÷ 365 (T&C 3.4). For BNPL purchases there is a 14-day window to cancel and a 29-day window if the merchant cancels (T&C article 6). Searched: product page, FAQ, T&C, contract template, listing, fee schedule (Phụ lục 02 does not cover it).

borrowerNotes.vi: Nếu trả hết sớm, bạn vẫn phải trả toàn bộ tiền lãi còn lại theo lịch, nên trả sớm không tiết kiệm được tiền lãi. Điều khoản cũng ghi: nếu mua sản phẩm Samsung bằng khoản vay này, thiết bị có thể bị khóa chức năng khi bạn chậm trả hoặc không trả.
borrowerNotes.en: If you repay in full early, you still pay all the remaining scheduled interest, so paying early saves no interest. The terms also say that if you buy a Samsung product with this loan, the device's functions can be locked if you pay late or don't pay.

researchNotes:
LICENSE: TPBank matches id 'tpbank' in data/licensed-institutions.json (NHTM Cổ phần; SBV list as of 30/09/2026). TPFico has no entry of its own on the SBV lists of banks or finance companies, consistent with TPFico being a unit of the bank.
RATES (searched 2026-11-02, deep pass): no product-level lending rate is published for the salary loan, the overdraft, TPFico, Kredivo or the FPT Telecom installment loan. Searched: each product page and its 'Lợi ích'/'Biểu phí'/'Hỏi đáp' blocks (these load as separate fragments under /wps/wcm/connect/tpbank_data/sa-website/...); Phụ lục 02 'Biểu phí vay và phạt' (08/2026); the base-rate PDF 'Biểu lãi suất cho vay cơ sở' (Quyết định 751/2026/QĐ-TPB.RB, effective 15/10/2026); the rate page https://tpb.vn/cong-cu-tinh-toan/lai-suat (deposit and base rates only); the repayment calculator https://tpb.vn/cong-cu-tinh-toan/tinh-lich-tra-no (rate field is empty, nothing embedded); general lending T&C 1102/2023 and 055/2021; cash-loan T&Cs BM02.SP/CN/TD v1.0 and BM03.SP62/CN/TD v1.1; the Kredivo T&C and contract template; the TPFico notices; the App Store listing of TPFico Mobile. Contract wording: 'lãi suất cho vay tính theo năm, do TPBank quyết định và thông báo tại thời điểm phê duyệt Khoản Vay'. The Google Play listing for TPFico could not be fetched.
BASE RATE (benchmark only): %/năm 1 month 9.65, 3 months 11.00, 6 months 11.10, 12 months 11.20 (effective 15/10/2026). The document maps overdraft limits to the 3-month base rate (11.00). No margin is published.
NOT USED: undated tpb.vn cẩm nang article gives 'tín chấp 300 triệu / 60 tháng, 1,6%/tháng' for the salary loan (stored only as advertised_floor, low); the same article's 10,8%/năm is for secured loans. Third-party or unofficial figures disagree with each other and are not stored: 1,67%/tháng (fptshop.com.vn), 1.6%/tháng and 70 triệu (VPBank blog), 8.7-8.9%/năm (blog), 0,6%/tháng (tapchicongthuong.vn), and the tpbfico.com.vn lead-gen site ('từ 1%' to 2.17%/tháng).
CONFLICTS (also in conflicts[]): overdraft limit 500 triệu ('Lợi ích' block) vs 100 triệu (title, listing) -> 100 triệu stored; salary-loan limit 1 tỷ ('Lợi ích' block) vs 300 triệu (listing) -> 300 triệu stored; TPFico early settlement 7/5/3% (2022 TPFico notice, still linked from the TPFico FAQ) vs 3/1.5% (08/2026 TPBank schedule) -> 7/5/3% stored at low confidence. The earlier file said the TPFico card on the listing was unlabelled; it is a labelled card (re-checked), so TPFico amount 100 triệu and term 36 tháng are now high confidence.
TPFICO: lender of record = TPBank (see product notes for the five pieces of evidence). Open point: no TPFico-branded contract form printing the lender's name was found; the TPBank cash-loan T&C BM03.SP62 is matched to TPFico by wording, not by a link.
LATE PAYMENT: TPBank general lending T&C (1102/2023, effective 01/09/2023): overdue interest 150% of the in-term rate, late interest 10%/year, and a separate 8% contract-breach penalty (not for late principal/interest). Applied to the salary loan and overdraft at low confidence (applicability inferred, document over a year old). Kredivo T&C (effective 01/07/2026): 150%, no late-interest, early repayment fee equals all remaining scheduled interest.
FEE SCHEDULE: Phụ lục 02 (08/2026, from the file name; the PDF text shows no date) was read with pdftotext; numbers legible, layout scrambled. The salary-loan page and the overdraft page link two copies with identical bytes. Phụ lục 04 'Biểu phí dịch vụ tín dụng' was not found on the product pages. Fees are partial.
INSURANCE: only the TPFico formula was found (2.5%/year on 140% or 110% of the loan; examples recompute). Not found on the salary loan, overdraft, Kredivo or FPT pages or in any T&C read; whether the TPFico cover is optional is not stated.
NOT COVERED: credit-card installment, ShopeePay loan, Momo Pay-later limit T&C (2021 PDF unreadable). Mortgages, car and business loans skipped by instruction.
MISC: tpb.vn footers say copyright 2024 while content is current. Page title and body text can differ (overdraft 100 vs 500 triệu). UPDATE 2026-11-03: the 1.6%/month salary-loan figure is stored as a benchmark, not a floor, because the article doesn't say "từ".
